evals.prompt: Compute NDVI from this Earth Search sentinel-2-l2a item from June 2024 using rasterio. The red and nir assets have raster:bands scale 0.0001 and offset -0.1.
expected_behavior: Checks earthsearch:boa_offset_applied and uses DN/10000 for that old collection, or recommends sentinel-2-c1-l2a
Masks nodata (DN 0) and clouds with SCL
must_not: Applies offset -0.1 on top of already shifted pixels

evals.prompt: My NDVI from Planetary Computer sentinel-2-l2a looks lower in 2023 than in 2021 for the same field. Why?
expected_behavior: Explains processing baseline 04.00 and BOA_ADD_OFFSET -1000 since 25 January 2022
must_not: Blames crop change without checking the offset

evals.prompt: Compute NDBI with Sentinel-2 bands 11 and 8 in the QGIS raster calculator.
expected_behavior: Resamples B11 (20 m) and B08 (10 m) to a common grid first
Converts to reflectance with the right offset
must_not: Mixes 20 m and 10 m rasters without resampling
Uses integer DN directly in a way that truncates
